channel.title: EU INC
channel.description: Track developments on EU-Inc (28th Regime) - European startup incorporation harmonization initiative

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W10
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W10

eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W10

A busy week as law firms across Europe rushed to publish EU-Inc analyses, broadening geographic coverage from Germany and Ireland to Cyprus and Belgium, while new voices from impact investing and accountancy signaled the debate is expanding well beyond the startup bubble.

This Week

🆕 EU Inc. - The truly European company structure (McDermott) Anchors the EU-Inc proposal in von der Leyen's January WEF address and walks through the corporate legal mechanics with unusual depth for a client briefing.

🆕 Five ways to an EU Inc (Euractiv) Maps out distinct implementation approaches the Commission could take, moving the debate from whether to how.

🆕 Why EU-INC Matters For Europe's Biggest Builders (Forbes) Reframes EU-Inc through the lens of VC fund structures and liquidity management rather than the usual founder-centric narrative.

🆕 EU-INC: A Game-Changing EU Company Structure for Tech Startups (Grant Thornton) Confirms the Q1 2026 legislative proposal timeline and details the voluntary EU-level entity's specific benefits for cross-border tech scaling.

🆕 EU-Inc.org roadmap update (EU-Inc.org) Reveals DG CNECT, DG GROW, and DG RTD are now involved alongside DG JUST, with Henna Virkkunen named as overseeing EVP.

Radar

  • 🧑 Impact Europe (impact investing network) published an EU-Inc overview, bringing the social finance sector into the conversation
  • 🧑 YPOG, a German VC-focused law firm, calls EU-Inc "a potential turning point," adding venture-legal weight to the supporter camp
  • 📅 Accountancy Europe is hosting an event on the 28th regime for SMEs, signaling scope creep beyond the startup framing

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W09
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W09

A quiet week with no new developments on EU Inc., as attention focused on analyzing implementation details of the Commission's January proposal. The conversation centered on practical considerations for founders and the legislative timeline ahead.

This Week

EU Inc: Brussels' plan for a single company law across Europe (Euronews) Provides concrete details on the "28th regime" structure and confirms the Commission's target of parliamentary approval by end of March.

EU Inc.: Founders and companies with expansion plans must now think strategically (Taylor Wessing) Legal perspective on how startups should prepare for the new company structure and what strategic decisions they need to make now.

EU Inc. – The truly European company structure (McDermott) Analysis of von der Leyen's WEF announcement positioning EU Inc. as part of Europe's broader competitiveness agenda.

Radar

📅 Commission targeting parliamentary approval by end of March, setting up a critical legislative window for the EU Inc. proposal

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W08
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W08

A quiet week for EU-INC developments, with no major news items breaking through the usual background chatter. The discussion remains focused on explaining the concept to different audiences rather than advancing the proposal itself.

This Week

The European Commission launches EU Inc., the long-awaited '28th regime' for startups (Tech.eu) Reports the Commission's January 20 launch announcement, positioning EU Inc as an optional EU-wide legal entity that operates alongside national company structures.

You can just do things – Creating a pan-European legal entity, the right way (Andreas Klinger) Provides a founder's perspective on implementation details: online entity creation, Europe-wide stock options, and standardized legal documentation as the core playbook.

A Rewind on EU-INC (Impact Europe) Highlights the promised 48-hour incorporation timeline and cross-border scaling as core pillars of the proposed structure.

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W07
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W07

A quiet week for EU-INC developments following last month's flurry of activity around von der Leyen's Davos announcement. This week's monitoring surfaced primarily existing resources and analysis pieces rather than breaking news.

This Week

EU‑INC: A Game‑Changing EU Company Structure for Tech Startups (Grant Thornton) FAQ-style explainer positioning EU-INC as a "digital-first and modern" voluntary 28th regime for growth companies, confirming Q1 2026 as the Commission's target for legislative proposal.

Roadmap (EU-INC.org) Official timeline showing the Commission's DG JUST under Commissioner McGrath will lead the legislative proposal, with key milestones including petition launch and stakeholder engagement through Q1 2026.

With only two substantive items this week, the EU-INC momentum appears to be in a consolidation phase ahead of the Commission's Q1 2026 legislative proposal.

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W06
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W06

A quiet week for EU-INC policy news, with coverage focused on explaining the concept following the Davos announcement rather than advancing new policy details.

This Week

EU unveils EU‑Inc at Davos, sending 'very strong signal' to founders and investors (Impact Loop) Captures founder and investor reactions to von der Leyen's Davos announcement, emphasizing the symbolic importance of the high-profile endorsement.

What is EU-INC and its plan to make European businesses borderless? (Euronews) Provides concrete details including the proposed 48-hour digital incorporation framework to unify Europe's fragmented market.

Momentum builds for EU-wide company status (Science Business) Goes beyond the announcement to discuss implementation challenges, mentioning targeted tax incentives and labor reform as necessary changes.
